text: You have successfully pleased the Blood God...
Successfully defeating the Vengeful Bloodshade has won this army's commander the favor of the Blood God. The Blood God cares only for blood, not its source...
After an interval of time attuned to Khorne's sacred number, the Vengeful Bloodshade has returned once more, continuing to offer up blood to its master.

Scouts bring word of a terrifying blood-red figure roaming north of the Great Bastion, drawing ever closer.\\nThis may well be yet another scheme of Cathay's great foe, Kairos the Fate-Weaver, but the Great Bastion shall still stand unbroken.
A vessel driven by an ominous blade, drawing strength from the act of killing.
'Blood Blade Death by Slicing' has received the Blood God's blessing; the eerie crimson glow along its blade can plunge onlookers into a bloodlust-fueled trance.
The thick miasma of blood that emanates from the Vengeful Bloodshade makes even Cathay's own soldiers tremble.
Blood spilled across the battlefield plunges the Vengeful Bloodshade into a gory hallucination of its family's slaughter, and every enemy before it appears as the very murderer of its kin.
The maddened will of the blade's forger lingers upon the Blood Blade's edge, its witch-like whispers greatly inflaming the host's bloodlust while numbing it to the pain of battle.
What forms the body of the host of 'Blood Blade Death by Slicing' is not flesh and blood, but a will seeking vengeance. The more it kills, the fiercer that vengeful will burns.
A skull wreathed in bloodfire, still bearing the twisted hatred of its final moment before death, cursing all the living...

'Blood Blade Death by Slicing' is an ominous blade forged by a famed Cathayan smith. It is said its maker had endured great national and familial tragedy, and sought to forge a divine weapon capable of extinguishing the beacon fires along the Great Bastion forever. Yet no matter how he tried, he could not perfect his craft, and in the end, consumed by obsession, he sacrificed his own blood — at last earning the Blood God's favor and completing this unrivaled weapon.\\nBut from the day of its forging, due to its inauspicious nature, it was watched over for generations by the noble Fu clan of Cathay. Later, a surviving descendant of the Fu clan, whose entire family had been slaughtered by the Chaos foe, made a pact with the blade out of vengeance — trading killing for power to exact his revenge. Yet from that moment, his body was bound to 'Blood Blade Death by Slicing,' and he was transformed into the Vengeful Bloodshade.

Kairos glimpsed another possible thread of fate within the Well of Eternity, and from it summoned Fu Yuanshan, already consumed entirely by the will for vengeance.\\nNothing remains within the depths of his heart save the impulse to destroy all things.
